quote: The El Arenal Hydropower Station located in Yoro province, in northern Honduras, which has a dam with a storage capacity of 52 million cubic meters of water and a total installed capacity of 60 MW. The project started construction on Feb 15, 2019 and was completed on April 26, 2022. It can generate 360 million kWh of electricity every year, serving about 1 million people.
note: Opened POWERCHINA English 27 Mar 2023 (El Arenal 60 MW COD Apr 2022).
